features: TRUWATT: C212 delivers true 20W stereo sound for a fuller, louder listening experience at any volume level.
DURAPLAY: Powered by a 2000mAh battery, enjoy a full day of music without recharging to 15 hours (*at 50% volume, LED off).
2.0 Channel + Dual Passive Radiators: Experience deep, punchy bass from dual passive radiators which push low frequencies further without distortion, giving you a true surround soundbar feel.
EZLink — Complete Connectivity Suite: Built-in FM Radio + Bluetooth 5.3 + AUX + USB + microSD — five ways to play, zero compromises
2X Power with TWS: Link two C212s wirelessly via TWS to instantly double your output to 40W stereo — turn any room into a sound-filled space without buying a separate speaker system.
Dynamic RGB LED — Sound-synchronised rhythmic RGB lighting that pulses with your music for an immersive visual & audio party experience.
Hands-Free Built In — The built-in mic means calls come through the speaker cleanly — no fumbling for your phone during music or meetings.
